flavorText.en: "We called her Ashraven for her flight, and the ruin she left in her wake." —Lord Saladin
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们称她为灰烬渡鸦，因其飞行之姿，以及留下的毁灭。”——领主萨拉丁

flavorText.en: "I think I've had a little too much peace and quiet." —Failsafe
flavorText.zh-CN: “我觉得我已经享受了太多安静平和的日子。”——智能失效保险

flavorText.en: …till we get a call from Washington, do you understand, we have to make the call ourselves and damn the consequences…
flavorText.zh-CN: …直到华盛顿来电，明白吗，我们必须自己做出决定，先别管后果…

flavorText.en: Raise your horn. Call the hounds. The hunt is on.

flavorText.en: "Believe in war, and nothing else." —Lakshmi-2

flavorText.en: Don't listen.
flavorText.zh-CN: 不要聆听。

flavorText.en: "They think violence will bring peace. Maybe it can." —Eris Morn
flavorText.zh-CN: “他们认为暴力能带来和平。也许还真可以。”——埃里斯·摩恩

flavorText.en: It will always finish what it started.

flavorText.zh-CN: 你的长矛跃起迎敌。

flavorText.en: Archival|Pollux|Director|1421| From the office of Dr. Bray: Whoever's supplying our plasteel is incompetent. One more chamber leak and I'll sue. Get me a new contractor.
flavorText.zh-CN: 档案|波鲁克斯|主任|1421| 来自布瑞博士办公室：为我们提供塑钢材料的供应商非常不称职。再有一起舱室泄漏事故，我就会起诉。给我找个新的承包商。

flavorText.en: "Barant Imperium came up outta nowhere—and they brought new energy tech with'em. I kitbashed this beauty 'outta their goods." —The Drifter
flavorText.zh-CN: “巴兰特帝国突然冒出来——还带来了新的能量技术。我用他们的货东拼西凑，做出了这件宝贝。”——浪客

flavorText.en: Where does one end and the other begin?
flavorText.zh-CN: 何处是尾，何处是头？

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成活动并在欧洲无人区中获得升级包。

flavorText.en: Shape: Shattered
flavorText.zh-CN: 塑形：碎裂

flavorText.en: There is so little left. And the cost, so high…
flavorText.zh-CN: 所剩不多。而代价却是如此高昂…

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：“战争领主的废墟”地牢

flavorText.en: A weapon forged from an ancient memory, purpose-built for your hand.
flavorText.zh-CN: 根据一段古代记忆制作出的，为你量身定制的武器。

flavorText.en: Clear and cold, forever.
flavorText.zh-CN: 透明而寒冷，直到永远。

sourceString.en: Source: Earned during the seasonal Dawning event.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：于赛季曙光节活动期间获得。

flavorText.en: "Your friend…"
flavorText.zh-CN: “你的朋友…”

flavorText.en: "Everything dies. This is proof." —Emissary of the Nine
flavorText.zh-CN: “万物终有一死。此为证据。”——玖的使者

flavorText.en: "Now stir the sauce…"
flavorText.zh-CN: “现在开始调味……”

flavorText.en: "Broken dreams are all I have left. Why should they be any different?" —Eris Morn
flavorText.zh-CN: “我所剩下的只有破碎的梦。他们又为什么要和我不一样呢？”——埃里斯·摩恩

flavorText.en: "This isn't happening. This isn't happening. This isn't happening."
flavorText.zh-CN: “这不可能发生。不可能。绝不可能。”

flavorText.en: A single word etched inside the barrel: "Sylvie-1."
flavorText.zh-CN: 枪管内部刻着一个名字：“希尔薇-1”

flavorText.en: "Imagine that as the last sound you hear." —Petra Venj
flavorText.zh-CN: “把它想象成你死前听到的最后声音。”——佩特拉·万吉

flavorText.en: Research|Notice|3213| —resulting from misuse of space gear will be deducted from the responsible party's paycheck. You have doctorates, folks. Act like it.
flavorText.zh-CN: 研究|通知|3213| ——因滥用太空装备而产生的费用将从责任方的工资中扣除。各位都是博士，拿出点博士的样子来。

flavorText.en: "Best part of having been inside the Traveler? I've got an argument to win." —Peach the Ghost
flavorText.zh-CN: “进入旅行者的最大收获是什么？我找到了之前争论的答案。”——机灵桃子

flavorText.en: Yes or no?
flavorText.zh-CN: 是或否？

flavorText.en: Some things never go out of fashion.
flavorText.zh-CN: 有些东西永远不会过时。

flavorText.en: Channel an aura of control over the energies of the universe.
flavorText.zh-CN: 散发着控制宇宙能量的气场。

flavorText.en: Retreat to the mind.
flavorText.zh-CN: 退至心灵。

flavorText.en: It makes a circle.
flavorText.zh-CN: 周而复始。

flavorText.en: "No oath will bind me to the past." —Kerrev, the Erased
flavorText.zh-CN: “没有誓言能将我缚于过往。”——被抹去者，克瑞夫

flavorText.en: Alone, unending, peerless.
flavorText.zh-CN: 独行无终，举世无双。

flavorText.en: SUROS invites you to the starting line.
flavorText.zh-CN: SUROS邀你来到起点线。

flavorText.en: Initiate or suppress.
flavorText.zh-CN: 启动或压制。

flavorText.en: Make sure to bury your enemies.
flavorText.zh-CN: 务必将敌人埋葬。

flavorText.en: Praedyth's fall isn't over… because it hasn't happened yet… and it will happen again.
flavorText.zh-CN: 普莱蒂斯的倒下不是结束…因为它还没有发生…而且它也会再次发生。

flavorText.en: Archaeologists understand: a buried hatchet is still, after all, a hatchet.
flavorText.zh-CN: 考古学家们明白：埋在地下的斧头说到底还是斧头。

flavorText.en: Entropy's lesson: one day we'll all be still.
flavorText.zh-CN: 熵之训诫：终归寂灭。

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：“永恒沙漠”史诗突袭

flavorText.en: "We go together."
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们休戚与共。”

flavorText.en: Light up the sky anew.
flavorText.zh-CN: 重新点亮天空。

flavorText.en: After all this time…
flavorText.zh-CN: 都已经过去那么久了…

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Crucible matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Shaxx.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成熔炉竞技场比赛并从领主沙克斯处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: "I will not end so easily." —Harrow, Dredgen Apprentice
flavorText.zh-CN: “我不会如此轻易就消亡。”——哈罗，德瑞捷学徒

flavorText.en: Now what did this do again?
flavorText.zh-CN: 这是做什么的来着？

flavorText.en: Sworn into faithful service to the Queen, the Techeuns of the Reef have long protected the secrets of the Awoken.
flavorText.zh-CN: 向女王宣誓忠诚的暗礁灵巫们已经保护觉醒者的秘密很久了。

flavorText.en:
A tale that's different from the rest: the thread unfurls against the clocks.
The one the Speaker loved the best must have a perfect paradox.
flavorText.zh-CN:
一个与其他故事迥异的传说：情节急转直下。
先知的最爱肯定拥有一个完美的悖论。

flavorText.zh-CN: 唯一重要的数字是你与目标之间的距离。

flavorText.en: "Let the Light be your compass." —Mithrax
flavorText.zh-CN: “让光能为你指明道路。”——米瑟拉克斯

flavorText.zh-CN: 枪管内部刻着一个名字：“威廉明娜-1”

flavorText.zh-CN: 生者早逝，杀手长生
